name: Somatic Reset
description: Body-based technique to release tension and improve physical awareness while mounted.
instructions: Place your horse and yourself in a safe, low-demand context (halt or easy walk) before starting this tool.

Follow this focus: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Name 3 things you see; light bilateral taps for 60–90s..  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
Continue for the suggested duration or several breaths/strides, then return to normal riding and briefly notice what feels different.
evidence_base: Somatic experiencing, body-based trauma therapy, polyvagal theory, and rider biomechanics research.
